subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

To pull the trigger

options.text: To insult and disgrace the people
To commit a course of action

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4** (To commit a course of action)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To pull the trigger"** often does not refer to literally firing a gun. 
 
• It is figurative language that refers to decisively carrying out an action or making a final decision.(किसी क्रिया को संपन्न करने के लिए निर्णय करना)
 
• The phrase which best expresses its meaning is** 'To commit a course of action'**, which implies deciding to act or starting an intended plan or decision. (किसी क्रिया को प्रारंभ करने का संकल्प)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is-* 'To commit a course of action'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is 'To make an exaggerated statement',(अतिरेकी में बयान देना)
 
• **Option 2 **is 'To do unnecessary things',(अनावश्यक काम करना)
 
• **Option 3** is 'To insult and disgrace the people',(लोगों का अपमान और बदनामी करना)
